new_results.statement: For a physical pivot a!=0 with Schur residual S=D+U Lambda U^T, D diagonal, U^T U=I_r, r>=3, row leverage <=1/2, Lambda invertible symmetric, arbitrary outside couplings are allowed and ||p_Q||_infinity <= 2 sqrt(r/(r-2)) B(U)^(1/r)|a|^(-1/2)|det Lambda|^(-1/(2r)) <= 2 sqrt(e r/(r-2))|a|^(-1/2)|det Lambda|^(-1/(2r)).
For U=(I3;I3)/sqrt(2), Lambda=diag(2,2,-2), D=I6/10, a=1, b=1_6/10 and C=S+bb^T, the block has at least three eigenvalues of modulus >1 and ||p_Q||_infinity <=2sqrt(3).
